from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the collection with its title and bibliography references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper")
    referenced_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers referenced in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
